points.description: States that a variable is a location/place in memory (or an area of memory). Accept 'memory location', 'place in memory', 'storage location in memory'; do not accept only 'container' or 'name' without any reference to memory.
points.partial_credit: Partial credit for identifying a location/container but omitting memory.

levels.says: Says a variable is a location/place/container for data but does not mention memory.
Only says that a variable stores data/information, without identifying it as a location or mentioning memory.

points.description: States that the memory location can store/hold a value (or data). Accept 'stores a value', 'holds data', 'contains a value'; do not accept only 'can be changed' or 'has a name'.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both that a variable is a memory location and that it stores/holds a value or data. Award partial credit on P1 if the answer gives a location/container but omits memory. No marks for answers that only give an unrelated or circular definition.
